source: Independent source-informed runtime and subset declarations; no upstream runtime copied. Original tests and MIT license retain attribution. Not a clean-room claim.

implementation.targetScope: React 19 Tiptap popover, dropdown menu and tooltip APIs used by VentiMath. Not the entire upstream public surface.

changes: Merged-ref cleanup releases all refs despite a throwing cleanup and rethrows the first error.
Modal cleanup preserves existing aria-hidden values, including false.
Owned hover timers and cancellable focus work; VPM positioning and tabbable foundations.

verification.runtime: 37 unchanged original tests plus nine focused integration/control scenarios on Node 24 and Bun.
verification.browser: Ten mounted Chrome checks for focus, ARIA, Escape, modal guards, menu navigation/typeahead and portal teardown.
verification.types: Packed npm/Bun installs, CJS/ESM identity, SSR, browser bundle and app-shaped TypeScript 7 NodeNext/bundler consumers.
verification.limits: No FloatingTree, safePolygon, transition, composite, virtual/grid navigation, editable-combobox typeahead or utils subpath. No React 16–18, Safari/Firefox, screen-reader or nested cross-shadow/iframe modal certification.
